about: Corpus examples that do not pass offline, each with a written reason. A triaged example is NOT passing: it is labeled not built, or a deliberate divergence the owner can overrule. tests/edge/corpus-evals.test.ts fails on any FAIL that is not listed here.

1.02.note: A first send to a new handle asks the person to type the handle back (PAY-002, confirmed in full) before the card; the corpus shows the card at once with a can't-verify line. Kept deliberately: it is the stronger check on a first, irreversible send to a stranger. Owner can overrule.

1.05.note: Balance-aware sends: the send flow does not read the funding account's balance, so it cannot say a $900 send won't go through or offer a savings move. Venmo/Zelle handoffs move money in the person's own app.

3.05.note: Finding a holding by company name ('palantir'): instruments resolve by ticker; there is no name index yet. The flow asks for the ticker instead of guessing.

1.06.note: Saved nicknames ('mom' for Anita Srikanth): saved_recipients has no nickname column, so 'mom' is not a saved name. The flow does not guess: it names the nearest saved person and asks, or takes NEW.
